title: On the Relevance of Incorporating Decision Dependence in Distributional Ambiguity
summary: Most existing studies on distributionally robust optimization (DRO) with a decision-dependent ambiguity set focus on the computational and theoretical challenges posed by this class of problems. In this paper, we adopt a combined modeling and computational perspective to understand the trade-offs between modeling fidelity, solution quality, and computational effort, particularly in comparison with DRO models using decision-independent ambiguity sets. Motivated by representative applications in joint pricing-stocking newsvendor problems with price-dependent demand and facility location…
